transcript: Wake up early and don't tell anyone. Go train and don't tell anyone. Eat healthy and don't tell anyone. Work on your goals and don't tell anyone. What people can't see they can't destroy. Listen to that again. What people can't see they can't destroy. Every time you share a plan too soon, you give others the chance to have an opinion, to doubt, to plant fear, and that fear gets inside you and stops what you had started with strength. In our monastery I learned that what grows in silence grows stronger. Bamboo spends years growing underground where no one can see it and when it comes out it grows meters in weeks because all the work was done in the dark. Your goals work the same way. While you protect them in silence they get stronger. The day you show them no one can destroy them anymore because the results speak for themselves. You don't need anyone to validate what you're doing. You don't need applause to keep going. You don't need to be seen for it to count. Work in silence and let the results make the noise. Write in the comments in silence if this reached you. But I want you to understand something. Most people don't share out of ego. They share out of emptiness. They need someone to tell them they're doing well because deep inside they're not sure and that insecurity comes from the stress of living without peace. When you don't have calm inside you look for validation outside. When you don't trust yourself you need others to trust for you. The day you build inner peace you stop needing anyone to applaud you. You work in silence not as a strategy but because you no longer need to be seen. And if you want to build that inner confidence that doesn't depend on anyone I've spent more than 20 years learning in silence how to do it and everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
